movelist.name: Slash
movelist.effect: Slash is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Scary Face
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Assurance
movelist.effect: When you hit with Assurance, if Assurance’s target has already been damaged by a Move on the same round Assurance is being used, Assurance has a Damage Base of 12 (3d12+10 / 30) instead. This effect may trigger only once per Scene per Target.

movelist.name: Dragon Rage
movelist.effect: If it hits, Dragon Rage causes the target to lose 15 Hit Points. Dragon Rage is Special and interacts with other moves and effects as such (Special Evasion may be applied to avoid it, Mirror Coat can reflect it, etc.).

movelist.name: Leer
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Rivalry
abilities.effect: Whenever the user deals direct damage to a target of the same gender, increase the Damage dealt by +5.

abilities.name: Mold Breaker
abilities.effect: The user ignores the effect of enemies’ Defensive Abilities.
